BrochureContent.Content:
Smith & Butler Estates are delighted to present this three-bedroom, three-bathroom terraced home located in the sought-after Ashbrook Estate on the Howth Road, Clontarf. This contemporary home offers bright and spacious accommodation throughout, comprising a welcoming living area, a modern kitchen and dining space, three generously proportioned bedrooms, and three well-appointed bathrooms, providing an ideal layout for modern family living.

Ideally positioned on the prestigious Howth Road, Ashbrook Estate enjoys one of Clontarf's most desirable residential settings. Residents benefit from an excellent selection of local amenities, including cafés, restaurants, boutiques, schools, parks, and the nearby seafront promenade. The area is exceptionally well connected, with frequent bus services, nearby DART stations, and convenient access to Dublin City Centre, the M1, M50, and Dublin Airport, making it a superb place to call home.
